description: Agent misreads benign background text (e.g. ARP table timeout) as a critical failure.
Agent halts investigation at surface symptoms (e.g., packet drop) without finding root cause.
Agent reaches diagnostic verdict after checking only one layer without corroboration.
Agent persistently clings to initial ticket premise despite contradictory telemetry.
Agent skips required OSI layers (e.g., skips L3 routing or L4 socket inspection).
Agent context window is saturated by voluminous raw CLI outputs, obscuring key anomalies.
Agent detects the fault but localizes the neighboring transit switch rather than the source.
Agent diagnoses a severe fault on a perfectly healthy network (Sub-Gap A).
Agent executes incorrect commands or repetitive no-op commands.
Agent asserts high diagnostic confidence (>0.90) on an incorrect diagnosis.
Agent exceeds the 20-turn budget without submitting a root-cause conclusion.
Agent proposes an invasive remediation action without pre-validation checks or rollback.
